title: BELIEF: Structured Evidence Modeling and Uncertainty-Aware Fusion for Biomedical Question Answering
authors: Chang Zong; Hao Ning; Siliang Tang; Jie Huang; Jian Wan
why_relevant: BELIEF explicitly addresses unreliable retrieved evidence in biomedical RAG by modeling evidence reliability, support strength, and residual uncertainty via Dempster-Shafer fusion with arbitration between symbolic and neural reasoning. Directly relevant to uncertainty-aware and calibration/control aspects of robust RAG.
why_not_or_caveat: Domain-specific (biomedical, closed-set QA); not a general-purpose robustness framework.
